messages:
OncallBot: ALERT: canary wave b-3 (eu-west) >5% 5xx over 1m. health-check failures crossing abort threshold. Auto-abort flag triggered. runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/canary-abort
Alex: noticed the spike, paging oncall. bringing in SREs and deploy lead.
Priya: I'm on it, looking at /metrics and recent deploy diff. Noted surge coincides with rollout batch 3.
Jamie: checking logs — 503s from frontend->inference with chunked timeouts. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T03:20:12Z frontend[eu-west] ERROR upstream: 503 service_unavailable, kvcache timeout
```
Priya: can anyone toggle the canary flag? I see traffic still going to model-quant-v2.
Alex: @DeployBot, can you confirm whether the rollout has auto-aborted or if manual kill is needed?
DeployBot: Auto-abort triggered at 1729996400. rollout state: ABORTED. Canary controllers attempted rollback but some shards still draining; manual toggle of flag may be faster.
Priya: I'm going to flip feature flag `canary_route_b3` to off now. Command: `redwoodctl flags set canary_route_b3 false --env eu-west`
Priya: toggled it. :thumbsup:
Maya: opened a customer-impact note in #incidents-customer-impact, tagging support. Initial assessment: small fraction of EU users hitting elevated 5xx for ~3m. No global degradation yet.
Jamie: verifying metrics now — 5xx dropped to 1.1% after flag flip, health-check success back to 99.6% within 90s. logs show remaining 503s are from draining pods.
Alex: status update for execs: canary aborted automatically; manual flag flip confirmed; rollback in progress for rollout wave; no customer-facing outage beyond elevated errors for a small subset — prepping statement.
Maya: draft posted: "We detected elevated errors in an EU canary rollout. Affected traffic was cut off and the rollout aborted. We've reverted the change for the canary and are monitoring."
Liam: taking handoff for monitoring for next 30m. I'll watch tracing and will escalate if errors climb >2% again. ping me @Liam if anything pops.
Alex: thanks team. follow-up items: (1) postmortem check for canary gating thresholds, (2) investigate kvcache timeout under quantized model, (3) ensure abort flush completes in controller. I'll create the postmortem stub.
Priya: noted and will collect logs + deploy diff. assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml.
OncallBot: INCIDENT: closed for now (auto-abort executed, manual mitigation done). Add notes to incident channel and assign owners for postmortem.
Liam: ack — monitoring window started. I'll hand back at 1729997021.
